whatAreCookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your actions and preferences over time. We also use similar technologies such as local storage and pixel tags — collectively referred to as "cookies" in this policy.

strictlyNecessary.label: Strictly necessary:
strictlyNecessary.description: required for core site functionality such as navigation, security, and remembering your consent choices. These can't be switched off.

performance.label: Performance & analytics:
performance.description: help us understand how visitors interact with the site so we can improve it (e.g. pages viewed, time on page, aggregate traffic sources).

functional.label: Functional:
functional.description: remember choices you make (like preferred language or region) to give you a more personal experience.

marketing.label: Marketing:
marketing.description: used by us or our partners to measure campaign effectiveness and, where applicable, show relevant content on other sites.

firstVsThird.title: 3. First-Party vs. Third-Party Cookies
firstVsThird.firstPartyDescription: cookies are set by this site.
firstVsThird.thirdPartyDescription: cookies are set by services we use — such as analytics, video, scheduling, or advertising providers. Third parties are responsible for how they use the data they collect; please review their own cookie and privacy policies.

howWeUse.title: 4. How We Use Cookies
items: Keep the site secure and functioning correctly.
Remember your consent and preference choices.
Measure traffic and understand how visitors use the site.
Improve content, performance, and user experience.

manage.title: 5. Managing Your Cookies
manage.intro: You can control cookies in several ways:

browserSettings.label: Browser settings:
browserSettings.description: most browsers let you block or delete cookies — check your browser's help pages.

optOutTools.label: Opt-out tools:
optOutTools.description: many analytics and advertising providers offer their own opt-out mechanisms.

consentBanner.label: Consent banner:
consentBanner.description: where required by law, you can update your consent choices via the banner or preference link on this site.

manage.footer: Blocking some cookies may affect how parts of the site work.

doNotTrack.title: 6. Do Not Track
doNotTrack.body: Some browsers offer a "Do Not Track" signal. There is no consistent industry standard for responding to it, so our site does not currently change behavior based on DNT signals.

changes.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Cookie Policy as our practices or applicable laws change. The "Last updated" date above reflects the current version.
